title: fix: degrade to static models when the community catalog query fails
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- `getGenerationModelRegistry` is on the path of every request that resolves a model, and the community-model D1 query it depends on had **no error handling**. One failing SELECT there 500s `/v1/models`, `/image/models` and every generation request.
- The realistic trigger is schema skew: a D1 migration lands before the Worker that understands it. There is always such a window during a production promotion.
- The 60s registry cache does not protect against this — it is per-isolate, so cold isolates miss it and load the registry immediately. Under production traffic new isolates start continuously.
- Catches the failure, serves `STATIC_ENTRIES` only, logs it. Degraded result caches for 5s instead of 60s so community models come back quickly.
- Test asserts static models still resolve when D1 reports a missing column.

gist.headline: The registry grows a spare hive
gist.blurb: If the community catalog trips over a migration mid-flight, generation no longer falls out of the sky. The static model shelf stays open while the catalog catches its breath.
gist.summary: Model resolution now catches community-model D1 query failures and falls back to STATIC_ENTRIES, keeping /v1/models, /image/models, and generation requests available while caching the degraded registry for 5 seconds.
gist.impact: During temporary D1 schema-skew windows, static models continue resolving instead of requests returning 500 errors, while community models reappear quickly after the query recovers.
